job.job_title: Sr. Azure Generative AI Engineer / Consultant
job.job_description:
Sr. Azure Generative AI Engineer / Consultant Location: India, Remote

Work Experience: 8+ Years

Requirements:
Hands-on experience in software development, cloud engineering, or AI-based solutions.
Strong hands-on experience with the Microsoft Azure cloud platform.
Experience building Generative AI applications using Azure OpenAI Service.
Experience implementing RAG architectures using Azure AI Search.
Hands-on experience with Azure App Services, APIs, and cloud-native application development.
Strong programming experience with Python, C#, or JavaScript.
Experience working with REST APIs, microservices, and cloud-based architectures.
Understanding of prompt engineering, LLM integration, and AI model orchestration.
Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices.
Experience with LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or similar LLM orchestration frameworks.
Knowledge of vector databases and embeddings.
Experience with Azure Functions, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), or containerized deployments.
Familiarity with data pipelines and data engineering workflows.
Azure certifications, such as Azure AI Engineer Associate or Azure Solutions Architect.

Qualifications: Bachelor s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

Design and develop Azure-native Generative AI applications using Azure AI services.
Implement LLM-powered solutions leveraging Azure OpenAI Service.
Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using Azure AI Search and vector-based search capabilities.
Develop scalable backend services and APIs using Azure App Services or related Azure compute services.
Integrate Generative AI solutions with enterprise applications and data platforms.
Optimize AI models and prompts to improve accuracy, performance, and cost efficiency.
Collaborate with data scientists, architects, and developers to deliver end-to-end AI-driven solutions.
Ensure solutions follow security, governance, and compliance standards within the Azure environment.
Monitor and maintain AI services for reliability, scalability, and performance.
Stay up to date with the latest Generative AI and Azure AI platform advancements.
